title: cymbalaria minor
intro: Cymbalaria minor, commonly known as Henbit or Small Pucklet, is a small annual herb in the mint family (Lamiaceae) that is native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, acting as an antiseptic, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cymbalaria minor include its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and promote better sleep. Its bioactive constituents include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
